flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 89% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -7% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Chemicals is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.76) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.

A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Bangladesh faces challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and..." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)
